summary: Eight games were played on Monday, and the home team won five of them. Golden State beat New Orleans 138-87, the night's largest margin at 51 points, and San Antonio beat Phoenix 122-96 behind 40 points from Victor Wembanyama. Anthony Davis scored a night-high 44 in a Washington loss at Detroit, while Dallas overcame a 13-point deficit to beat Indiana 125-122 as Cooper Flagg scored 43.

games.headline: Hornets pull away from Cavaliers 124-112
games.story: Charlotte led 69-53 at halftime after a 40-point second quarter and was ahead by as many as 33. Cleveland never led by more than 9, and Charlotte went ahead for good at 29-26 in the final minute of the first quarter. Grayson Allen scored 27 and Naz Reid had 25 points and 13 rebounds for the Hornets, who made 23 of 46 threes. Meleek Thomas led Cleveland with 18.

games.headline: Lakers beat Hawks 124-114 behind Doncic's 32
games.story: Los Angeles led 68-57 at halftime and was up by as many as 20, after taking the lead for good at 23-22 late in the first quarter. Luka Doncic had 32 points, 8 rebounds and 10 assists. Sandro Mamukelashvili scored 23 and Walker Kessler added 21 points and 10 rebounds. CJ McCollum scored 21 for Atlanta, which made 17 of 44 threes. The Lakers did not have Austin Reaves.

games.headline: Pistons beat Wizards 122-111 despite Davis' 44
games.story: Detroit led 68-58 at halftime and by as many as 19, after going ahead for good at 33-32 early in the second quarter. Anthony Davis scored 44 points with 13 rebounds for Washington, and AJ Dybantsa added 21. Three Pistons scored 22 or more: John Collins had 24 points and 10 rebounds, and Duncan Robinson and Daniss Jenkins each scored 22. Jalen Duren did not play for Detroit.

games.headline: Grizzlies pull away from Raptors 118-102
games.story: The lead changed 7 times in the game, and Memphis went ahead for good at 42-41 with 5:32 left in the second quarter. The Grizzlies led 59-53 at halftime. They built a lead of 16, and Toronto never led by more than 6. Ty Jerome scored 27 and Cameron Boozer had 22 points, 7 rebounds and 8 assists for Memphis. Jamal Shead had 20 points and 11 assists for the Raptors.

games.headline: Flagg scores 43 as Mavericks edge Pacers 125-122
games.story: Indiana led 66-56 at halftime and by as many as 13, but Dallas went ahead for good at 98-97 with 9:36 left in the fourth quarter. Cooper Flagg scored 43 points with 10 rebounds and 6 assists, and Kyrie Irving added 35 for the Mavericks. Pascal Siakam had 29 points, 9 rebounds and 8 assists for the Pacers. Indiana made 15 of 35 threes and Dallas made 14 of 34.

games.headline: Rockets beat Nuggets 110-100 despite Murray's 38
games.story: Houston led 54-40 at halftime and by as many as 19, and went ahead for good at 62-60 with 4:14 left in the third quarter. Denver never led by more than 2. Jamal Murray scored 38 and Nikola Jokic had 25 points, 16 rebounds and 9 assists for the Nuggets. Kevin Durant added 23 points and 12 rebounds for Houston, and Alperen Sengun had 20 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists.

games.headline: Wembanyama's 40 lead Spurs past Suns 122-96
games.story: Victor Wembanyama scored 40 points with 11 rebounds as San Antonio took a 61-46 halftime lead and built a lead of 34. Phoenix never led by more than 1, and the Spurs went ahead for good at 26-25 in the first quarter. Dylan Harper added 17 points and De'Aaron Fox had 15 points, 9 rebounds and 6 assists. Devin Booker scored 32 for the Suns, who had no other player above 11.

games.headline: Warriors rout Pelicans 138-87, a 51-point win
games.story: Golden State led 72-43 at halftime and by as many as 51, which was the final margin. New Orleans never led by more than 1, and the Warriors went ahead for good at 5-3 in the first quarter. Brandin Podziemski and Stephen Curry each scored 25, and Yaxel Lendeborg had 23. Golden State made 21 of 44 threes to New Orleans' 8 of 28. Derik Queen led the Pelicans with 16.
